What the week creates

week-13 — nine resources, two of them outside the resource group
$ terraform state list
    data.azurerm_client_config.current
    data.azurerm_policy_set_definition.diag_to_law
    azurerm_key_vault.target
    azurerm_log_analytics_workspace.diag
    azurerm_network_security_group.target
    azurerm_public_ip.target
    azurerm_resource_group.diag
    azurerm_role_assignment.kv_writer
    azurerm_role_assignment.remediation
    azurerm_storage_account.target
    azurerm_subscription_policy_assignment.diag

# azurerm_subscription_policy_assignment and its role assignment are at
# SUBSCRIPTION scope. Deleting the resource group would leave both
# behind, still trying to remediate into a workspace that is gone.
#
# The initiative itself is Azure's. It is looked up by display name
# rather than GUID: a bare GUID in a .tf file is indistinguishable
# from a leaked identifier to secret-sweep.sh.
